messages.subject: installing RApache
parts:

I follow the configure steps as metioned. I get held up on the make.
It has a problem creating the mod_R.so file.

Here is the output:

Thanks,
Brian

messages.author: ca5dd90d5422193f
messages.subject: Re: installing RApache
parts:
I'm actually getting the same error from apxs when I "make install" as
per the instructions from "2.3 Quick Install for Debian/Ubuntu" (see
below).

Any ideas on what could be causing it? I'm running Ubuntu 9.10 - the
Karmic Koala.

Tommy


2.3 Quick Install for Debian/Ubuntu
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
apt-get install r-base-dev apache2-mpm-prefork apache2-prefork-dev
wget http://biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu/rapache/files/rapache-latest.tar.gz
rapachedir=`tar tzf rapache-latest.tar.gz | head -1`
tar xzvf rapache-latest.tar.gz
cd $rapachedir
./configure
make
make install
